content: IndexedDB quota varies by browser/device (desktop: hundreds of MB to GBs; mobile: as low as 50MB). Firefox best-effort mode caps at min(10% of disk, 10GiB). Eviction is LRU across origins when disk fills, and Safari/mobile may evict long-unused origins outright. Writes must be wrapped in try/catch for QuotaExceededError; recommended mitigation is proactively deleting old data before writing new.
